Bihar Weather Alert : bihar men tuphan 'arnab' ka asar dekhne ko mil raha hai. barish aur tej havaon ke karan rajy ke 21 jilon men phaslon ko bhari nuksan pahunchne ki khabar hai. mausam vibhag ne 27 jilon men yelo alart jari kiya hai, jabki sitamrhi aur madhubni men red alart ghoshit kiya gaya hai.
Tuphani mausam ke bich kisanon ki chinta barh gaee hai. janie bihar ke mausam ka taja apdet aur kin jilon men alart jari kiya gaya hai.
